label: ok
sentence: Usually these trees are small in diameter and/or are of poor quality (not large enough to make pulpwood or sawtimber).

label: ok
sentence: Forest residue material is generally composed of limbs and tops from operations where the primary products are pulpwood and sawtimber.

label: ok
sentence: The material removed from the tree during processing is placed in a chipper or grinder and blown into a chip van for delivery.

label: ok
sentence: The third category is clean chip residual, which is the material remaining after trees go through a chain-flail debarker to remove the bark, limbs, and top.

label: ok
sentence: This material consists of more bark and foliage than the previous categories.

label: ok
sentence: Also, the team will collect different fractions (bark, limbs and tops, clean chips) from five woody biomass types (yellow pine, red and white oak, sweetgum and yellow poplar) that are prevalent in Alabama.

sentence: Task 3: Biochar Production and Characterization (AU) Biochar will be produced from collected biomass using a rotary kiln, that has a 6-inch diameter tube, at three temperatures (500o, 600 oC and 700 oC) to understand the effect of pyrolysis temperature on biochar properties.
